flags.why: In this sense, đảo describes rapid movement around or back and forth, especially of the eyes, rather than generic shaking or wagging ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=đảo)).
flags.fix: to move rapidly around or back and forth; to dart (the eyes)

flags.why: Chừng does not mean to pause or slow down halfway; the entry confuses it with chững ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=chừng)).
Tôi bao anh sẽ thích món này is not a natural Vietnamese construction for guaranteeing that someone will like something.
flags.fix: Giá này bao vận chuyển. = This price includes shipping at no extra cost.

flags.why: Bao before an adjective is current colloquial usage, so rare misleadingly discourages a familiar modern expression ([usage example](https://www.reddit.com/r/VietNamNation/comments/1eybgyw)).
Ả refers contemptuously to a woman and does not itself mean that she is a villain or schemer ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/%E1%BA%A2)).
